Input image: EDIT TARGET, the existing approved L-sofa living room. Keep this SAME ROOM, shell, view, warm palette, parquet and cinema wall. Apply THREE requested furniture edits together:

1) REPLACE the fluffy rounded L sofa with a visibly MORE STRUCTURED, TAILORED sofa in warm oatmeal flat-woven linen. Crisp mostly straight lines, slim squared arms, firm slim rectangular seat/back cushions, a low clean back and discreet short dark wooden feet. Natural comfortable upholstery but NOT puffy, not cloud-like, no boucle, no inflated rounded tubular arms, no overstuffed cushions. Retain a connected true L, main run facing the movie at the rear, return on image RIGHT. Use restrained olive accent cushions and only one neatly folded small throw. Slightly smaller footprint around 2.70m across x 1.95m deep. Shift the entire sofa LEFT toward the middle about 60cm and FORWARD toward the projection about 45cm, leaving a real gap to the right bookshelf and making room behind the sofa.

2) ENLARGE the freestanding right-wall wooden bookcase substantially: a continuous furniture piece with FIVE elegant book-filled open bays, about THREE METRES along the right wall, 34cm deep, about 2.2m high, extending from near the rear corner toward the foreground. Books, a few ceramics and restrained warm integrated shelf lights; some closed lower cabinets. It is a timber bookcase in front of the existing wall, not new holes or recesses in the architecture. Leave about 65cm clear between the outside of the sofa's right return and the FRONT of this shelving for reaching the books. Preserve the arched niche bookshelf on the left.

3) ADD a slim warm wooden SIDEBOARD immediately BEHIND the main back of the sofa, on the window/facade side, PARALLEL to and centered on the sofa back: 2.30m long x 35cm deep x about 70cm high. It is a closed storage sideboard with plain doors, visible in this overview between sofa and windows, NOT the existing media cabinet on the far wall and not at the side of the sofa. Keep its top just below the sofa back. Put the small warm shaded table lamp on its left end and a small potted plant on its right end; remove the former little round sofa side table. Replace the floor plant formerly immediately behind the sofa with this small sideboard plant. Leave about 1.2m between sideboard and front facade, and maintain open balcony access. 

Keep ONE olive armchair on the rear-left side of the seating area; move the small round stone table into the inner angle of the new L. Rug may shift with the sofa. Main pedestrian route remains clear along the LEFT.
Room shell is approx 5.64m across x 5.015m deep. Keep exact same large front balcony glazing, smaller right front window and grille, left-wall opening, rear doorway, niche, projection on the rear wall and existing low media console. No new door/window/fireplace/beams; no architectural expansion, no extra seating.
Match image quality, viewpoint, lighting and warm cozy atmosphere, but let the sofa look visibly slimmer, firmer and more refined. Wide landscape. No labels or text.
